facts: All 13 problems were discovered 2026-08-31 with research_status=current; remedy evidence is 7 days old and none of it is stale.
12 of 13 problems have at least one remedy record with status=active; only P-20260831-ED2DC8D6 has no remedy (its primary study offers no mitigation strategy).

Security-lane (S0) problems are all general mechanism problems: vendors patched specific instances (CVE-2026-54316 in Claude Code 2.1.163, CVE-2026-12537 in Gemini CLI 0.39.1, CVE-2025-59536 in Claude Code 1.0.111) but the same classes kept producing new fixes through v2.1.251 (2026-08-28) and the 2026-08-20 Codex changelog.

Claude Code issues #87575, #88041, #87971 (bash-edit path bypassing checkpoint/hooks/permission matchers) were open with no maintainer response as of 2026-08-31; Anthropic docs describe the checkpoint gap as an intended limitation and acceptEdits auto-approves sed/mv/cp, so the mechanism is partly by design.

For P-20260831-FB4523EC: the current run MNT-20260907T190654Z again recorded authority_base.reachable=false / remote_sha=null (third consecutive unreachable recording), while a direct `git ls-remote origin HEAD` executed during this review succeeded and returned 6f9374740c48db87aab04081043ddfabff62d983 == local_head.
scripts/check_authority.py contains no reference to authority_base/reachable, so the fail-closed gate proposed by RMD-AUTHGATE-001 is not yet implemented.
P-20260831-8968B75A rests on a single study in one domain (Oracle->PostgreSQL migration); its own remedy record flags that effect sizes may not transfer to feature development.
P-20260831-ED2DC8D6 rests on a single 34-participant crossover experiment with no independent replication and only a vendor blog as adjacent material.
inferences: No problem qualifies for 'mitigated': every vendor fix observed addresses an instance, not the core mechanism (per the review rule that instance patches do not mitigate a general mechanism problem).

The two single-study problems (spec portability, LLM-assisted requirements inspection) are plausible but not yet corroborated broadly enough for 'active'; 'watch' with replication triggers is the right lane.

For FB4523EC the discrepancy between the run record (reachable=false) and actual live reachability suggests the reachability probe itself is recorded at session start and may be unreliable, which strengthens rather than weakens the problem: the ledger plans against an unverified base even when verification would have succeeded.

risks: No external web verification was performed this session; judgments rely on 7-day-old remedy research. For the fast-moving harness problems (AE8A3EE7, 60EFB5BF) a vendor fix shipped in the last week would not be reflected — short next_review intervals compensate.
The reachable=false vs live-reachable discrepancy for FB4523EC should be investigated by the controller: the probe method in maintenance_plan.py may be failing while git egress actually works.
recommended_action: Apply the 13 proposed statuses (11 active, 2 watch). Prioritize implementing RMD-AUTHGATE-001 in check_authority.py and fixing the reachability probe for FB4523EC, since the current run reproduces the problem while the remote is demonstrably reachable. Schedule replication checks for the two watch items.

evidence.title: OWASP AST08
